carpet.rule.piglinIgnoreGoldTrim.desc: Piglins treat players wearing armor with gold trim the same as players wearing gold armor.
carpet.rule.commandSend.desc: Use the `/send` command to open the quick mail interface, offering a more convenient option similar to fakeplayer mailing.
carpet.rule.commandSmallFix.desc: Use the `/smallfix` command to switch between normal and small size.
carpet.rule.netheriteHoeGlassSpeed.desc: The Netherite hoe can speed up mining of glass-type blocks.
carpet.rule.undeadAvoidCinnabar.desc: Cinnabar can ward off evil spirits.
